parameters.voice_description: An original English-speaking mascot voice for Merc, an ageless liquid-metal adventure sprite who reads as a young adult. Masculine-leaning and grounded with a warm low-mid register, compact resonance, calm confidence and understated dry comic timing. Deliberate but not slow, with a subtle smile and only a slight musical lift. Crisp natural articulation for short game dialogue. Dry, close-mic studio recording with excellent audio quality; no music, background sound or reverb. Moderate conversational volume, never booming or shouting. A friendly encouraging coach, never cynical, gravelly, trailer-like, announcer-like or imitative.
parameters.text:
A little note can break glass.

Hum a comfortable note.

Beautiful. A new path is open.

Gorgeous. Absolutely gorgeous.

You broke that with your voice. I need to sit down. I don't have legs.
